title: The Word became flesh
description: John's Gospel opens with a theological prologue about the Word who was with God from the beginning and through whom all things were made. The Word became flesh and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth. John the Baptist testified to the light that came into the world, but his own people did not receive him. Those who received him were given the right to become children of God. The law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
